getJointStates: get joint positions, velocities, and torques for all joints of a pybullet robot body
getMotorJointStates: get positions, velocities, and torques for only motor joints of a pybullet robot body
setJointPosition: set position control targets for all joints of a pybullet robot with configurable kp and kv gains
multiplyJacobian: multiply a pybullet robot jacobian matrix by a joint velocity vector to compute spatial velocity
calculateJacobian: calculate the linear and angular jacobian matrices for a robot end-effector link in pybullet
